title: Brass bands, 'Ole Miss' and W.C. Handy
summary: Allen notes the brass band influence; 'Ole Miss' is played, dated about 1950-52 after Wiggs left the St. Charles, and Allen talks about Handy.

bands.name: Johnny Wiggs and His New Orleans Kings

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues
